name: JW Marriott, Anaheim Resort
positioning: Family-focused JW Marriott resort a short walk from Disneyland Resort, with a rooftop bar overlooking the fireworks and its own JW Garden
best_for: Families visiting Disneyland Resort who want to walk to the parks
Families who want bunk-bed suites with space for the kids

facts.text: The resort is a short walk from Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure Park and Downtown Disney District.
A private pathway connects the hotel to Anaheim GardenWalk, with its outdoor dining and entertainment.
The hotel is a Disneyland Resort Good Neighbor Hotel and its concierge can help with multi-day Disneyland Resort Park Hopper tickets.
The outdoor heated pool is open year-round and has luxury cabanas.
The resort grows its own herbs and produce in the JW Garden for use in dishes and drinks.
The JW Garden is also a Pollinator Garden of California native plants that support local wildlife.
Every room has a large walk-in shower with a stand-alone bathtub.
Some rooms and suites have views of the nearby theme parks.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes and state-of-the-art equipment.
A Yoga and Zen Room offers in-person and digital classes.
Tocca Ferro Italian Chophouse follows a seed-to-table philosophy, making dishes from scratch, including hand-rolled pasta and dry-aged beef.
Family events run through the week, such as cookie decorating on Thursdays and movie nights on Saturdays.

highlights.text: Parkestry Rooftop Bar & Lounge offers sweeping skyline views and, on select nights, views of the Disneyland fireworks.
Bunk Bed Suites have a twin-top and queen-bottom bunk so children get their own space.
The Family Bunkbed Suite can sleep up to six people in two separate bedrooms.
The tenth-floor Executive Lounge has a wraparound terrace with views over Anaheim and the nightly Disney fireworks.

considerations.text: Executive Lounge access is complimentary for Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite members; other guests need to book a room with lounge access.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the location is busy during peak Disney seasons.
